# CatalystLab

> CatalystLab is a multi-dimensional web health, OWASP security, WCAG accessibility, and AI readiness telemetry platform. It provides instant automated audits across 8 specialized diagnostic engines with real-time edge latency testing and JSON/PDF reporting.

## Core Telemetry Engines & Tools
- [Website Health Analyzer](https://www.catalystlab.tech/health): DOM depth, bundle size, and DOM node count auditing.
- [Global Edge Latency Radar](https://www.catalystlab.tech/latency): TTFB testing across 12 global edge PoPs.
- [AI Readiness Inspector](https://www.catalystlab.tech/ai-readiness): /llms.txt and LLM crawler indexability validation.
- [Repository Hygiene Scanner](https://www.catalystlab.tech/repo-scanner): OWASP security header and secret exposure scanning.
- [Eco-Carbon Footprint Audit](https://www.catalystlab.tech/eco-audit): Green hosting and serverless carbon emission calculation.
- [Compliance & Risk Mitigation](https://www.catalystlab.tech/compliance): WCAG 2.2 accessibility and OWASP Top 10 compliance.
- [AI Search Optimization (LLMO)](https://www.catalystlab.tech/llmo): Perplexity and SearchGPT citation visibility.

## Documentation & API
- [Developer Docs](https://www.catalystlab.tech/docs): REST API endpoints, webhook alerts, and CI/CD GitHub Actions integration.
- [Pricing & Capabilities](https://www.catalystlab.tech/pricing): Community, Pro, and Enterprise tiers with automated 60-minute health probes.
- [Technical Blogs](https://www.catalystlab.tech/blogs): Deep technical investigations into web architecture, SecOps, and AI search vectorization.
